For privacy, consider using an earpiece.

KASA needs one setting turned on so it can read MTN menus aloud for you and choose options you approve. Your PIN is never touched — it always goes straight into the phone\'s own PIN screen. Tap below to open Settings, find KASA, and turn it on.
Also check: in Settings → Accessibility → TalkBack, \"Speak passwords\" should be OFF, so your PIN digits are never read aloud.
